26
Usia ahennie mfitiaseɛ pa
1 # 2 Ah 14.21-22; 15.1-7 Na Yuda man no nyinaa faa Usia, na wadi mfirinhyia dunsia, na wɔsii no hene n’agya Amasia ananmu. 2Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree Elot, na ɔdane maa Yuda, akyire yi a ɔhene no tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando. 3Usia dii mfeɛ dunsia na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduonum mmienu wɔ Yerusalem. Na ne na din de Yekalia a ɔfiri Yerusalem. 4#2 Be 25.2 Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, sɛdeɛ n’agya Amasia yɛeɛ no ara. 5Na ɔhwehwɛɛ Onyankopɔn nna a Sakaria a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn adehunu mu nhunumufoɔ no wɔ hɔ no nyinaa, na nna nso a ɔhwehwɛɛ AWURADE no, Onyankopɔn maa no dii yie.
6Na ɔfirii adi kɔnee Filistifoɔ koe, na ɔbubuu Gat fasuo ne Yabne fasuo ne Asdod fasuo, na ɔkyekyeree nkuro Asdod ho ne Filistifoɔ no mu. 7Na Onyankopɔn boaa no tiaa Filistifoɔ ne Arabfoɔ a na wɔtete Gur-baal, ne Meunifoɔ no. 8Na Amonfoɔ de apeatoɔ brɛɛ Usia, na ne din hyeta kɔduruu Misraim, na ne ho yɛɛ den kɔɔ so pa ara. 9Na Usia totoo aban atentene wɔ Yerusalem, ntweaso pono no so, ne bonhwa pono no so ne emu fam ntweaso no so, na ɔhyehyɛɛ no den. 10Na ɔtotoo aban atentene nso ɛserɛ so, na ɔtutuu mmura pii, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔwɔ mmoakuo bebree mpaperɛ ne asaseta so. Ɔwɔ akuafoɔ ne bobeturoyɛfoɔ, mmepɔ so ne Karmel so, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔpɛ kua. 11Na Usia wɔ dɔm a wɔdi ako a wɔtu sa asafo soɔ, sɛdeɛ wɔn nkaneeɛ a wɔnam Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Yeiel ne Ɔpanin Maaseia so kan wɔn no ano teɛ, wɔn nso na wɔhyɛ Hanania a ɔfiri ɔhene asafohene no mu no aseɛ. 12Agyanom atitire a wɔwɔ mmarima akofoɔ no mu no nyinaa ano si mpennu ahansia. 13Na ɛdɔm a ɛhyɛ wɔn aseɛ a wɔtumi wɔn ho ano si mpemahasa ne mpemnson ahanum, akofoɔ a wɔwɔ tumi ne ahoɔden de boa ɔhene tia atamfoɔ. 14Wɔn na Usia siesiee akyɛm, mpea, nnadeɛkyɛ, nkataboɔ, ntadua ne ntɔmmoɔ maa wɔn, sɛ wɔmfa mma dɔm no nyinaa. 15Na ɔyɛɛ adetoɔ mfidie a ɛyɛ adwumfoɔ adwini wɔ Yerusalem, sɛ ɛnsisi aban atentene so ne afasuo ntweaso, na wɔmfa ntoto agyan ne aboɔ akɛseɛ. Na ne din tahye kɔɔ akyirikyiri pa ara, na ɔnyaa mmoa a ɛyɛ nwanwa kɔsii sɛ ne ho yɛɛ den.
Usia fom asɔfoɔ
16 # 2 Be 25.19 Na ne ho yɛɛ den no, ɔyɛɛ ahantan na ɔbɔɔ brafunu, na ɔfomm AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔhyɛnee AWURADE asɔredan mu sɛ ɔrekɔhye aduhwam aduhwamhyeɛbukyia no so. 17Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Asaria dii n’akyi, na AWURADE asɔfoɔ aduɔwɔtwe, nnipa a wɔtumi wɔn ho ka ne ho. 18#Num 18.7 Na wɔkɔgyinae ne Ɔhene Usia dii asie, na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Usia, ɛnyɛ wo deɛ sɛ wobɛhye aduhwam ama AWURADE, na ɛyɛ asɔfoɔ, Aaron mma a wɔayɛ wɔn kronkron sɛ wɔnhye aduhwam no dea. Firi adi firi kronkronbea ha yi, na woafom, na w’anim nyɛ nyam AWURADE Nyankopɔn anim. 19Na Usia bo fui, na aduhwamhyeɛ adeɛ no kura ne nsam sɛ ɔde rebɛhye aduhwam no. Na ɔfaa asɔfoɔ no ho abufuo no, kwata fifirii ne moma so, asɔfoɔ no anim, AWURADE fie hɔ, aduhwamhyeɛbukyia no ho. 20Na Ɔsɔfopanin Asaria danee n’ani kyerɛɛ no, ɔne asɔfoɔ no nyinaa, na hwɛ, wayare kwata ne moma so, na wɔpiapiaa no firii hɔ, na ɔno ara nso yɛɛ ntɛm firii adi, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE aka no.
21 # Num 5.2 Na Ɔhene Usia yaree kwata kɔsii ne wuda, na ɔtenaa ayarefoɔ fie sɛ ɔkwatani, na wɔsii no AWURADE fie kwan. Na ne ba Yotam dii ɔhene fie no so, na ɔbuu asase no so man no atɛn. 22#Yes 1.1; 6.1 Na Usia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, akane deɛ ne akyire yi deɛ no, Amos ba Odiyifoɔ Yesaia atwerɛ. 23Na Usia tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no n’agyanom nkyɛn ahemfo asieeɛ asase no so, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɔyaree kwata. Na ne ba Yotam bɛdii n’adeɛ.

Na Yuda man no nyinaa faa Usia, na wadi mfirinhyia dunsia, na wɔsii no hene n’agya Amasia ananmu. Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree Elot, na ɔdane maa Yuda, akyire yi a ɔhene no tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando. Usia dii mfeɛ dunsia na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduonum mmienu wɔ Yerusalem. Na ne na din de Yekalia a ɔfiri Yerusalem. Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, sɛdeɛ n’agya Amasia yɛeɛ no ara. Na ɔhwehwɛɛ Onyankopɔn nna a Sakaria a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn adehunu mu nhunumufoɔ no wɔ hɔ no nyinaa, na nna nso a ɔhwehwɛɛ AWURADE no, Onyankopɔn maa no dii yie.

Na Onyankopɔn boaa no tiaa Filistifoɔ ne Arabfoɔ a na wɔtete Gur-baal, ne Meunifoɔ no. Na Amonfoɔ de apeatoɔ brɛɛ Usia, na ne din hyeta kɔduruu Misraim, na ne ho yɛɛ den kɔɔ so pa ara. Na Usia totoo aban atentene wɔ Yerusalem, ntweaso pono no so, ne bonhwa pono no so ne emu fam ntweaso no so, na ɔhyehyɛɛ no den. Na ɔtotoo aban atentene nso ɛserɛ so, na ɔtutuu mmura pii, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔwɔ mmoakuo bebree mpaperɛ ne asaseta so. Ɔwɔ akuafoɔ ne bobeturoyɛfoɔ, mmepɔ so ne Karmel so, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔpɛ kua. Agyanom atitire a wɔwɔ mmarima akofoɔ no mu no nyinaa ano si mpennu ahansia. Na ɛdɔm a ɛhyɛ wɔn aseɛ a wɔtumi wɔn ho ano si mpemahasa ne mpemnson ahanum, akofoɔ a wɔwɔ tumi ne ahoɔden de boa ɔhene tia atamfoɔ. Wɔn na Usia siesiee akyɛm, mpea, nnadeɛkyɛ, nkataboɔ, ntadua ne ntɔmmoɔ maa wɔn, sɛ wɔmfa mma dɔm no nyinaa. Na ɔyɛɛ adetoɔ mfidie a ɛyɛ adwumfoɔ adwini wɔ Yerusalem, sɛ ɛnsisi aban atentene so ne afasuo ntweaso, na wɔmfa ntoto agyan ne aboɔ akɛseɛ. Na ne din tahye kɔɔ akyirikyiri pa ara, na ɔnyaa mmoa a ɛyɛ nwanwa kɔsii sɛ ne ho yɛɛ den.

Na ne ho yɛɛ den no, ɔyɛɛ ahantan na ɔbɔɔ brafunu, na ɔfomm AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔhyɛnee AWURADE asɔredan mu sɛ ɔrekɔhye aduhwam aduhwamhyeɛbukyia no so. Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Asaria dii n’akyi, na AWURADE asɔfoɔ aduɔwɔtwe, nnipa a wɔtumi wɔn ho ka ne ho. Firi adi firi kronkronbea ha yi, na woafom, na w’anim nyɛ nyam AWURADE Nyankopɔn anim. Na Usia bo fui, na aduhwamhyeɛ adeɛ no kura ne nsam sɛ ɔde rebɛhye aduhwam no. Na ɔfaa asɔfoɔ no ho abufuo no, kwata fifirii ne moma so, asɔfoɔ no anim, AWURADE fie hɔ, aduhwamhyeɛbukyia no ho. Na Ɔsɔfopanin Asaria danee n’ani kyerɛɛ no, ɔne asɔfoɔ no nyinaa, na hwɛ, wayare kwata ne moma so, na wɔpiapiaa no firii hɔ, na ɔno ara nso yɛɛ ntɛm firii adi, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE aka no.

Na Usia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, akane deɛ ne akyire yi deɛ no, Amos ba Odiyifoɔ Yesaia atwerɛ. Na Usia tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no n’agyanom nkyɛn ahemfo asieeɛ asase no so, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɔyaree kwata. Na ne ba Yotam bɛdii n’adeɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
